articles.title: Silver futures rise to ₹2.08 lakh per kg
articles.excerpt:
Silver prices rose 0.27 per cent to ₹2.08 lakh per kg in futures trade on Thursday amid a firm global trend.

On the Multi Commodity Exchange, the white metal for December delivery rose by ₹561 or 0.27 per cent, to ₹2,08,899 per kilogram in a business turnover of 3,125 lots.

Fresh positions built by participants led to a rise in silver prices, analysts said.

In the overseas market, silver futures rose 0.61 per cent to $55.89 per ounce.

articles.title: Rupee hedging turmoil exposes strain in India's FX market
articles.excerpt:
Indian rupee forward premiums rose to multi-year highs on Thursday after the central bank’s latest foreign exchange curbs rattled markets, sapping liquidity and making it difficult for traders to manage exposures, several bankers said.

The turmoil has strained a key segment of India’s currency market, where companies hedge exchange-rate risks and banks manage balance-sheet exposures.

The one-year implied hedging cost has jumped more than 90 basis points this week to 4.6 per cent, its highest since January 2022 and well above the roughly 2 per cent implied by the India-US interest-rate differential.

articles.excerpt:
Imports of refined edible oils declined sharply to 7.40 lt in the first 11 months of the oil year 2025-26, from 16.89 lt in the corresponding period of the previous oil year. | Photo Credit: istock.com

India’s edible oil imports increased by 3.27 per cent during the first 11 months of the oil year 2025-26 (November-October), supported by higher palm oil imports.

articles.excerpt:
